## Description

Please include a summary of the change, which converter module it touches, and the motivation behind the change.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] UI/UX or Accessibility improvement

## Tested On

- [ ] Google Chrome (Desktop / Mobile)
- [ ] Mozilla Firefox
- [ ] Apple Safari (macOS / iOS)
- [ ] Microsoft Edge

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the project's zero-backend client-side policy (no network transmission of images).
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand canvas rendering operations.
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation if necessary.
- [ ] My changes generate no new browser console errors or warnings.
